bullet: Pause and interrupt a terminal conversation (`F05.pause-terminal`).
script:
for CASE in "$A:finished" "$E:error"; do
  CID=${CASE%%:*}
  S=${CASE#*:}
  control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --check execution_status eq "$S"
  N=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --field .)
  control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/pause" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.pause-terminal/pause
  control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/interrupt" --expect 200 --check success eq true --save F05.pause-terminal/interrupt
  control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --check execution_status eq "$S"
  control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq "$N"
done
